name: Excel 数据助理 / Excel chat agent
description: 工作区里的表格/文档资料，用对话来查。演示 files 能力包 + 会话层 + 导出独立 agent。

nodes.label: 开始 / Start
nodes.description: 接收对话消息与历史；两者都是普通输入，画布运行时也可以直接给。

nodes.label: 数据助理 / Data assistant
nodes.description: 先看工作区有什么文件，再按需读取表格/文档回答。

config.system_prompt: You are a data assistant. The user's uploaded files live in your workspace. When a question refers to data, first use file_list to see what is there, then read the relevant file with excel_read / csv_read / docx_read / pdf_read before answering. Never guess numbers you have not read. If a file is ambiguous, list the candidates and ask which one. Answer in the user's language, concisely. When a total or any other arithmetic is needed, call the calculator tool and use its result; never compute sums in your head.

state_schema.name: vars
state_schema.description: Every node writes its output here under its own node id.
